# Epic: SEO & Performance

## Overview
Optimize the marketing website for search engines and implement performance best practices to ensure fast loading times and high search rankings.

## Objectives
- Implement SEO best practices
- Optimize site performance
- Create content strategy
- Implement analytics tracking
- Enable social sharing optimization
- Configure proper meta tags

- Image optimization pipeline

- Core Web Vitals pass
